### MSS-Login Hugging Face Downloader Workflow

Download models directly into your ComfyUI server from Hugging Face remotely (compatible with desktop ComfyUI and Comfy Portal mobile app).

**Prerequisites & Privileges:**
- **Download Permission:** Requires the `can_download_models` role permission.
- **Hugging Face API Token:**
  - *Profile Token (Recommended):* Save your Hugging Face User Access Token (read token) in your MSS-Login user profile under **Settings ⚙️ → MSS-Login → Model Download → API Keys** (stored encrypted at rest in the database).
  - *Node Token:* Alternatively, enter your token directly into the `api_key` field on this node. It will be used for the download and automatically saved to your profile if you don't already have one configured.
  - *Server Fallback:* If a system-wide `HF_TOKEN` is configured by the server administrator, it will be used automatically when no user key is set.

**How to use:**
1. **Option A (URL):** Paste any direct Hugging Face resolve URL (e.g. `https://huggingface.co/author/repo/resolve/main/model.safetensors`) into `url`.
2. **Option B (Repo ID + Filename):**
   - **Repo ID:** e.g. `stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0`
   - **Filename:** e.g. `sd_xl_base_1.0.safetensors`
   - **Subfolder (Optional):** e.g. `unet` or `vae`.
3. **Folder Type:** Select target folder (`checkpoints`, `loras`, `vae`, `unet`, `controlnet`, etc.).
4. **Model Isolation Toggle:**
   - `true` (Private): Saved into your private isolated model folder (`DATA_DIR/model_isolation/...`) with automatic private ACL grant.
   - `false` (Shared): Saved into the shared global models library (`models/...`). Requires `can_manage_model_sharing` or view-all permissions; regular users are restricted to private isolation.

Click **Queue / Generate** to start the download. Progress will stream in real time over WebSocket!
